_about: What the kanban questions need one step beyond what a team records, and what a policy forbids. Reasoned about in `why`, confirmed in `validated_by`.

rules.why: Comparing two boards' policies needs every policy that holds on a board in one place; a policy of the board itself is one of them.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-02 (walked through in the ontology interview)

rules.why: A team records a policy on the column it governs; comparing boards needs it on the board too.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-02 (walked through in the ontology interview)

then.flag: a card has two moves on the same day: keep the one that says where it ended up that day, or the board on that date and the card's latest column are ambiguous

rules.why: Moves are compared by day; two on one day make the card's column that day, and its latest column, a coin toss.
rules.validated_by: Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-11-02 (walked through in the ontology interview)
